SELECT u.id, u.username, u.bio, COALESCE(f.cnt, 0) AS follower_count
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT followee_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM followers GROUP BY followee_id
        ) f ON u.id = f.followee_id
        ORDER BY u.id
        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
